assetPolicy.fighterImages: Manual licensed assets only. Do not scrape or copy fighter images into the repo.
assetPolicy.fallback: Use abstract asset slots with small country markers until licensed images are provided.

modeling.principle: Make source stats easy to scan without pretending missing samples prove weakness.

formulas.earlyThreat: round-one wins as a share of sourced wins, softened by total completed sample
formulas.lateEvidence: late-round appearances plus average fight time; confidence measure only
formulas.styleProfile: UFCStats career rates normalized to 0-100 with manual opponent-quality snapshot

fights.matchupQuestion: Can Strickland keep the fight in repeatable boxing minutes before Chimaev compresses the space?
fights.fightShapeSummary: The clean read is not early equals good and late equals bad. Chimaev's source profile creates an early control alarm; Strickland's source profile creates a minutes-and-volume test.
fights.manualRead: If Chimaev has a round-one-heavy resume, that raises early danger. It does not automatically lower his round-three-to-five ability; it lowers confidence because there is less late-round evidence.
